title: Intern with SDPD's Crime Lab!
description:
Investing in San Diego's youth! The City's fully state-funded Employ & Empower internship program offers young San Diegans the year-round opportunity to gather professional experience that can help them launch a career in public service. 

Briyan shares his experience as an intern at SDPD's crime lab. Learn more about our internship program at sandiego.gov/Employ-Empower.
